doc: Per platform and chat app: how a tapped reply reaches the input box TODAY. Statuses: fresh-verified (target re-read right before writing and matched -> auto fill), copy-only (cannot be proven -> the reply is copied, the person pastes). The code is the truth and this file describes it: each platform's tests assert that what production does (Android: each adapter's fillSupport, which the fill path obeys; Windows: FILL_SUPPORT, checked against uia.PARSERS and fill_reply) equals this declaration, so when the code changes this file changes in the same commit.
